locator.text: Display 87.6, p. 87, in the proof of Corollary 7.8

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary:
Lean has an equivalent formula. All three lines are available for the constructed fields on the domain where the paper asserts them; they are spread over several declarations and are stated before the auxiliary-torus average and for all nine tensor components.

Lines 1 and 2 are pure algebra with no NativeData hypothesis. covariance_increment_exact gives C(U+V) - C(U) = B(U,V) + B(V,U) + B(V,V) for the 3x3 angular-average tensor (the paper's B(U,V) + C(V) with B symmetrized, (7.23) on p. 82). incrementTensor_split (via covariance_increment_split) and signedRemainder_exact split it as symmetricCovariance primary tangent + symmetricCovariance (old - primary) tangent + symmetricCovariance old curl + bilinearCovariance (tangent+curl) (tangent+curl), i.e. B(W_0^as, L^as Sigma) + B(E, L^as Sigma) + B(U,R) + C(V) with E = U - W_0^as. Applying meanBar and taking components (0,1), (0,2) gives the paper's two-vector identity.

Line 3 (B(W_0^as, L^as Sigma) = Sigma, the paper's (7.36)). In the paper this holds on the active domain 0 < q < q_big <= 2^{-l_0}, with labels restricted to bands l >= l_0 (pp. 62, 64, (6.8); p. 65 states the squared-partition identity "on the active shell"). The Lean mirrors this: labels are the cells of band >= N = (choice B N0).prepared.N; requested_cross_factor states, for every band n and every point of ActualInitialization.geometry.strip.domain, meanBar (actualCross 0 i.succ) n x = partitionFactor B N0 n x * requestedStress ... n x i; partitionFactor_eq_one gives partitionFactor = 1 whenever physicalScale n x <= Q N. So Sigma exactly holds wherever the physical scale is at most Q N, which contains the paper's domain when N plays the role of l_0. requested_cross_tail and family_requested_cross_tail package this for whole bands n >= N+1 (physicalScale_tail); the part of band N with coordinateQ <= 1 follows from the same two declarations. family_cross_eq transfers it to SignedMeanGain.crossTensor of the cycle's family.

Outside that domain (bands n <= N-1 and the part of band N with coordinateQ > 1, all at physical scale > Q N) the Lean also carries charts the paper does not have; there requested_cross_defect gives cross - Sigma = -missingWeight * Sigma, and the main route (CorrectionAnalyticStep.step -> SignedCrossDefectClass.residual_defects_all_exponents_of_primitive -> CrossBasedMeanComposition.signed_mean_gain_of_cross_defects) writes meanBar(cross) = Sigma + crossDefect and keeps the defect, which vanishes from band N+1 on. This is additional to the display, not a gap in it.

Remaining differences: Sigma in these statements is the requested stress of an arbitrary context and state (requestedStress c u), not an arbitrary two-vector in M_alpha; the chain is never assembled into one declaration; the identification of N with l_0 and of physicalScale with q is read off the label type and mask sums, and no Lean object for q_big was looked for.

The earlier pairing's SignedMeanGain.native_family_cross (:1284) stays dropped: it takes SignedMeanGain.NativeData G, which no_legacy_nativeData shows is empty on ActualInitialization.geometry. SignedMeanGain.native_physical_cross (:510) has no NativeData hypothesis (it needs 1 <= N, 0 < q, q <= Q N and a cone condition) and states the cross identity for an arbitrary sigma on the model nativeAssembly; nothing links it to the constructed blocks, so "uses" at most.
